item.title: Hotfixes: January 30, 2026
item.description:
World of Warcraft

Hotfixes: January 30, 2026

Blizzard Entertainment

Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that address various issues related to World of Warcraft: The War Within, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Season of Discovery, Burning Crusade Classic, WoW Classic Era, and Hardcore. Some of the hotfixes below take effect the moment they were implemented, while others may require scheduled realm restarts to go into effect. Please keep in mind that some issues cannot be addressed without a client-side patch update. This list will be updated as additional hotfixes are applied.

Hotfixes

January 30, 2026

Classes

  • Fixed an issue where full health targets with a heal absorb were not considered injured for some AoE healing logic.
  • Demon Hunter
    • Devourer
      • Fixed an issue causing Voidsurge to not correctly function without Demonic Intensity.
      • Void-Scarred: Fixed an issue causing Hungering Slash to not work properly after using Metamorphosis.
      • Consume now generates 1 additional Soul Fragment.
      • Shattered Souls now has a 4% chance to cause a damaging spell to generate a Soul Fragment (was 8%).
      • Waste Not now causes Void Ray to have a 200% increased chance of generating a Soul Fragment (was 100%).
      • While in combat, Entropy now grants a Soul Fragment every 12 seconds (was 8 seconds).
      • Reap damage increased by 75%. Does not affect PvP combat.
      • Consume damage reduced by 30%. Does not affect PvP combat.
      • Fixed an issue causing Devourer Demon Hunters to sometimes switch to an incorrect voice during Void Metamorphosis.
  • Mage
    • Frost
      • Glacial Bulwark no longer requires level 54.
  • Rogue
    • Deathstalker: Fixed an issue that caused Precise Killer to apply double its listed effect.
    • Subtlety
      • Trickster: Fixed an issue that prevented Disorienting Strikes from applying its cooldown reduction effect for Secret Technique.

Housing

  • Elegant Elven Barrel can now be added as decor.

Items

  • New drops of Rae'shalare, Deaths Whisper should again be legendary.

Pet Battles

  • Webbers is now properly displayed once awarded from Family Battler of Northrend.

Player versus Player

  • Fixed an issue that prevented progress towards the Vicious Void Creeper mount during the PvP offseason.
  • Warrior
    • The effectiveness of the low-health effect of Second Wind has been reduced by 50% in PVP.

Twilight Ascension Event

  • Added crossbows as options for players to acquire from the event.
  • Fixed an additional issue preventing visibility of "Void Perforations" if the player had completed the Firebeard's Patrol questline.
  • Quartermaster Materialist Ophinell now has an icon on the minimap.

January 28, 2026

Housing

  • Increased the House XP cap to 2250 XP +250 XP per Endeavor completion, for a total of 2500 per Endeavor.
  • Adjusted diminishing returns for repeatable tasks to increase rewards after multiple repetitions of activities.
  • Improved the rewards for the non-Endeavor-specific tasks.
  • For the first (current) month only: significantly reduced the amount of Endeavor XP needed to complete the bar for the first Endeavor cycle.
    • Developers’ notes: This is intended to compensate for the fact that it’s the first month, and there is no record of player activity.

Items

  • Fixed an issue that caused Dragonflight raid cloaks to convert to a set item not intended for your class.
  • Added a sell price to the Ascension Arrestor's Dagger.

Quests

  • Fixed a bug that caused returning level 80 players to be directed to the incorrect content.
  • Fixed an issue causing players to be unable to use the Path of the Chosen to progress quests during Xal'atath Lorewalking.
  • Players can again complete "Nuke 'Em Norbit" in Mechagon as intended.

Twilight Ascension Event

  • Resolved an issue where the scenario UI was not available during the Mirrorvise rare event.
  • Ritualist and boss health has been adjusted to make them last a bit longer for large groups.
  • The price of gear on the vendor has been reduced to 20 Insignias (was 40).
  • Champion track Warbound-until-equipped items will no longer generate an ‘Epic Upgrade’ notification when looted from rares.
  • Equipment drops are no longer restricted to only one per day, per character, from each individual rare.
  • [With realm restarts in each region] Rares now spawn every 5 minutes (was 10 minutes).

January 27, 2026

Classes

  • Death Knight
    • Blood
      • Fixed an issue with Bloodied Blade not granting Strength.
  • Druid
    • Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Germination, and Wild Growth once again extend their duration when they are refreshed.
    • Restoration
      • Fixed an issue where Passing Seasons was not reducing the cooldown of Nature's Swiftness.
  • Hunter
    • Marksmanship
      • Fixed an issue causing Tame Beast to not correctly function when talented into Unbreakable Bond.
    • Survival
      • Fixed an issue causing Raptor Strike to have incorrect damage and focus costs when using Aspect of the Eagle.
  • Monk
    • Brewmaster
      • Fixed an issue causing Celestial Infusion to not absorb any damage.
      • Fixed an issue causing Celestial Brew and Celestial Infusion to display an incorrectly low tooltip value.
  • Priest
    • Renew, Holy Fire, Vampiric Touch, and Shadow Word: Pain once again extend their duration when they are refreshed.
    • Shadow
      • Fixed an issue causing Shadowy Apparitions to not display properly on Damage Meters.
  • Rogue
    • Hero Talents
      • Fatebound
        • Fixed an issue that caused Ravenholdt Mint's benefit to not be applied or reduce overall damage.

Dungeons and Raids

  • De Other Side
    • Resolved a visual issue with Mueh'zala's Shattered Visage

Player versus Player

  • Fixed an issue where Precognition could trigger on a successful interrupt.
  • All class spells that apply crowd control will now appear larger on raid frames and be prioritized over other debuffs.

Quests

  • Alleria should now be available to provide "After the Storm" for eligible players who have started the Lorewalking Recap but have left it before completing.
  • Added Jaina and Thrall in Stormwind and Orgrimmar to allow eligible players to pick up The War Within intro quests.

Transmogrification

  • Lowered the cost of outfit creation prices by 50% to bring them more in line with what the prices were prior to the Transmog update.
    • Developers’ notes: This hotfix was applied to live servers on January 23.

Twilight Ascension Event

  • Tripled the chance for equipment to drop from Twilight Ascension rares.
  • Increased the number of Twilights Blade Insignias dropped by killing Twilight Ascension rares to 2-3 (was 1).
  • Twilight Ascension rares will no longer drop level-up equipment that your character cannot wear.
  • Removed faction tapping from enemies during "Twilight's Call" rare events.
  • Resolved an issue where players could send other players through the portal to Dornogal in the Twilight Ascension basecamp.

The Burning Crusade Classic

  • Fixed a rare bug where characters who received a Level 58 Character Boost did not learn all their spells.
  • Book "Soothsaying for Dummies", used to re-choose profession specializations for Leatherworking and Engineering, has been temporarily disabled while we resolve an issue with it granting the wrong specialization.
    • Developers’ notes: We're aiming to have the book reenabled in the not-too-distant future and will post a hotfix note when that happens.
  • Fixed an issue where raid frames were not correctly displaying whether a player was in-range or not.
  • Fixed an issue where pets with auto-cast spells would cause client performance to degrade over time.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the pre-expansion event to disable briefly.

January 26, 2026

Classes

  • Demon Hunter
    • Devourer
      • An issue causing the Soul Fragments of Devourer Demon Hunter to not function on the Dawnbreaker has been resolved.
  • Druid
    • Restoration
      • Grove Guardians no longer cost mana when they are summoned.
  • Monk
    • Mistweaver [with scheduled realm maintenance]
      • Thunder Focus Tea's cooldown reduced to 30 seconds (was 45 seconds).
      • Mana Tea effectiveness increased by 20%.
  • Shaman
    • Enhancement
      • An issue causing Maelstrom Weapon to require level 12 has been resolved.
    • Restoration
      • Chain Heal healing increased by 25%.
      • Healing Rain healing increased by 82%.

Dungeons and Raids

  • The random Heroic Dragonflight dungeon queue should now require the correct average item-level.
  • Temple of Sethraliss
    • Fixed an issue that caused the Avatar of Sethraliss encounter to become soft-locked.
  • Vault of the Incarnates
    • Fixed several issues with the Raszageth encounter not cleaning up properly when a player is defeated on Story Mode.

Horrific Visions

  • Item-level rewards will no longer be displayed on the Horrific Vision event widget.
    • Rewards increase based on how far you get in a Horrific Vision run at the new squished item levels appropriate for Season 3.

Housing

  • Daily rotating Endeavor quests no longer reset on logout, and are now Weekly quests, and are now all up at the same time.
  • The Grand Collector now has an increased tap limit, allowing many people to get credit for the Endeavor task "Blade of the Skyguard" at once.
  • Some decor that was accidentally hidden in the catalog has been made accessible:
    • Murloc Driftwood Hut
    • Scroll of the Adherent
    • "Rising Glory of Rukhmar" Statue
    • Shellscale Standard
    • High Arakkoan Alchemist's Shelf
    • High Arakkoan Shelf

Items

  • [With scheduled realm maintenance] The item-level of gear provided by the Level 80 Boost has been increased to 102 (was iLvl 80).

Trading Post

  • [With scheduled realm maintenance] A new Trading Post activity has been added to January: "Legion Remix: Mix Up". The timelines have bent once more, granting the efforts of some to all. Players who log-in during the month of January will earn 650 points for their Traveler's Log.

January 22, 2026

Characters

  • The XP buff from the Warband Mentors: The War Within set of achievements should now be applying correctly on characters below level 80.
  • Corrected an issue that incorrectly enabled legacy content scaling for characters who were leveling up in Dragonflight.

Classes

  • Death Knight
    • Unholy
      • Developers’ notes: We’re looking into the throughput imbalance for Unholy Death Knight in the pre-expansion update. These changes will not impact 12.0.1, as Unholy received substantial updates between 12.0.0 and 12.0.1.
      • Rider of the Apocalypse Horsemen damage reduced by 50%.
      • Trollbane's Icy Fury damage increased by 100%.
      • Lesser Ghoul Sweeping Claw main target damage reduced by 50%.
      • Lesser Ghoul melee damage reduced by 50%.
      • Pet Ghoul Sweeping Claw main target damage reduced by 50%.
      • Pet Ghoul melee damage reduced by 50%.
      • Death Coil damage reduced by 30%.
      • Scourge Strike damage reduced by 30%.
      • Infected Claws damage reduced by 50%.
      • Putrefy main target damage reduced by 30%.
      • Morbidity now increases the damage taken by 1% per disease on target (was 2%).
      • Raise Abomination Disease Cloud effect reduced to 10% (was 20%).
      • Epidemic damage increased by 25%.
      • Clawing Shadows chain damage penalty reduced to 15% (was 25%).
  • Mage
    • Frostbolt is now located in the Frost Mage section of the Spellbook for easier access.

Delves

  • Fixed a bug causing Brann’s experience bar to also mention Valeera.

Dungeons and Raids

  • Fixed a bug preventing some encounters from progressing through their stages correctly (e.g. the Neltharion encounter in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible).
  • Resolved an issue causing some creatures in Nerub'ar Palace and Liberation of Undermine to have very low health.

Housing

  • Elegant Elven Barrel can now be added as decor.
  • Lightly Broken Fences found around the neighborhood can now be repaired.

Mage Tower

  • Developers’ notes: With the Midnight pre-expansion update now live, we’re adjusting enemy health in several Mage Tower challenges to bring them back toward their intended pacing and difficulty.
  • Closing the Eye
    • Enemy health increased by 20%.
  • An Impossible Foe
    • Enemy health increased by 20%.
  • The God-Queen’s Fury
    • Enemy health increased by 15%.
  • Feltotem’s Fall
    • Enemy health increased by 20% for all specializations except Discipline Priest, for which there is no adjustment.
  • Thwarting the Twins
    • Enemy health increased by 20%.
  • The Highlord’s Return
    • Enemy health increased by 15%.

Player versus Player

  • Adjusted the effectiveness of Training Grounds opponents.

Quests

  • The Campaign header should now appear for War Within campaigns.
  • Resolved issues with the quest "Distilled Darkness" causing the K'areshi Fragments to be uninteractible for some players.
    • Developers’ notes: If any issues are being encountered, please submit a bug report of what happened prior to the quest failing and identify which fragment is causing the issues (Northern, Southern, or both).

Transmogrification

  • Addressed an issue causing Midnight Special Edition transmog sets to not be usable at lower levels.

January 16, 2026

The Burning Crusade Classic

  • Fixed an issue where Blackrock Spire only allowed 5 players to enter.
  • Fixed a bug preventing the quest “The First and Last” from starting for eligible players.
  • Cleansed Songflowers now apply their buff to the clicking player, not the player's target.
  • Paladins should now be able to learn Consecration from their trainer as intended.
  • Shamans who were unable to learn Two-Handed Maces and Two-Handed Axes from the weapon trainer should again be able to.
    • Developers’ notes: Players may need to log out and back in to pick up this fix.
  • Player versus Player
    • The current active increase to Honor gains is now 150% (was a 100% bonus).
    • Added level 51-60 versions of the “For Great Honor” (Horde) and “Concerted Effort” (Alliance) quests.
    • Developers’ notes: Soon after launching the Burning Crusade pre-expansion patch, we could see that PvP needed an additional increase in rate of gearing. These quests award 400 Honor (at level 60) when handed in, as well as experience for players from levels 51-59. These quests do not require Eye of the Storm, and their text will soon be updated to reflect that. When the Dark Portal opens, these quests will no longer be available, and the level 61-70 versions of these quests will become available.

January 14, 2026

The Burning Crusade Classic

  • Restored character Boost services after a brief outage.
  • Enabled Arena Skirmishes, as intended.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Addons to be unintentionally throttled.
  • Returned the Chronoboon Displacer to its adjusted cost of 1 gold and stack size of 10.

The hotfix notes for the previous update can be found here.

item.title: Introducing the WoW Ambassador Program: Find Your People
item.description:
World of Warcraft

Introducing the WoW Ambassador Program: Find Your People

Blizzard Entertainment

World of Warcraft has always been more than just a game—it’s a universe where friendships are forged, epic stories are written, and heroes unite from every corner of Azeroth. With the official launch of the WoW Ambassador Program, we invite you to find your people and experience the game alongside like-minded players.

What is the WoW Ambassadors Program?

The WoW Ambassador Program is designed to empower dedicated and experienced players who want to help shape the World of Warcraft community, both in-game and beyond. Our vision is simple: foster engagement and connection among players, ensuring everyone feels at home, whether they are a veteran raider or just starting out in Azeroth.

How the Program Works

Community is the heart of WoW, and Discord servers have become the modern taverns where players gather, strategize, and make friends. Through the WoW Ambassador Program, official and partner Discord communities nominate standout members to represent WoW’s spirit of camaraderie. Ambassadors help welcome new players, organize activities, and amplify the sense of belonging that sets WoW apart. Participating Discords enjoy special recognition, access to exclusive events, and direct support from Blizzard—making every server a more vibrant place to connect.

WoW Portal Room: Your Gateway to Community

Launching alongside the program, the WoW Portal Room is the official World of Warcraft Discord server—a hub where Ambassadors and players unite. Here, Ambassadors serve as guides, event organizers, and community champions, ensuring every adventurer feels included. Whether you’re seeking a new guild, tips for mythic dungeons, or simply want to chat, the Portal Room is where you will take the first steps to finding your people. Just like using a portal in World of Warcraft, the portal room is meant to be a way stop on your journey and not the final destination.

How to Sign Up

Ready to become an Ambassador and your Discord community join the program? Signing up is easy. Applications are now available. Once all the applications are reviewed, players will be able to meet up with the chosen Ambassadors in the WoW Portal Room beginning February 26 to find their fit.

Join Now

Choose Your Path

The launch of the WoW Ambassador Program marks a new opportunity for players to connect in meaningful ways and is built for everyone. Whether you’re leading raids, crafting stories, or just seeking new friends, this is your chance to become part of something bigger. Step into the Portal Room, connect with Ambassadors, and help us create a world where every player is recognized, included, and celebrated.

Check back here on the official World of Warcraft site for more information!

item.title: Black Ops 7 Season 02: Full Intel
item.description:
Call of Duty

Black Ops 7 Season 02: Full Intel

Call of Duty Staff

New Threats Rise: Black Ops Season 02 is Here!

The Story So Far

The Guild may be down, but it’s not out. Alden Dorne has a secret weapon and a key ally: neural scientist Victoria Atwood. The ruthless and ambitious Atwood leads The Guild’s technology branch, and her leadership spearheading the company’s most clandestine research programs is about to yield dividends.

After capturing David Mason for Project Synapse, Dorne works closely with Atwood, using Mason’s mind to try and recreate the technology behind C-Link. Why invoke fear when you can control all emotions?

Season 02 Roadmap

Please note that due to the colossal content drops across the entire season, not all Season 02 Reloaded content is shown.

Gear up and focus in as the battle escalates with an incredible amount of free and premium content, starting when Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Season 02 launches on Thursday, February 5 at 9 a.m. PT.

item.title: The 2.6.0 PTR: What You Need to Know
item.description:
Diablo IV

The 2.6.0 PTR: What You Need to Know

Blizzard Entertainment

The 2.6.0 Public Test Realm (PTR) for Diablo IV will be available from February 3, 10:00 a.m. PST to February 10, 10 a.m. PST, offering you the chance to test upcoming changes and features coming in the next season for the base game, shaking up how you play across both Eternal and Seasonal Realms.

The purpose of the PTR is to test updates and features before the launch of the next season, where we’ll be focusing on a vicious new Killstreak system, powerful Bloodied Items, murderous Bloody Sigils, and more.

Using your feedback, we’ll make adjustments before the next season goes live. This helps us to fine-tune balance changes, eliminate bugs, and create the best experience possible while testing new systems. Thank you for playing through the PTR and sharing your thoughts with the team.

Here is what the 2.6.0 PTR will preview ahead of next season.

A Note on the Upcoming Season

Season 12 is designed as a more focused, streamlined season that supports our broader roadmap toward launch of The Lord of Hatred expansion on April 28, while still delivering a fresh, rewarding and fun experience for players.

The 2.6.0 PTR will preview the foundation of the season, while more surprise features will be revealed closer to launch. As always, we are keen to hear your PTR feedback to ensure S12 is the best it can be!

Codex

Unleash Your Rage with Killstreak System

Rain Crimson with Bloodied Items

Unlock Slaughter with Bloodied Keys

New Unique Items

Features Offered for Testing

How to Provide Feedback

How to Install the PTR

2.6.0 PTR Patch Notes

Unleash Your Rage with Killstreak System

Indulge in bloodthirsty carnage to grow progressively stronger—maintain a fast, efficient slew of kills to increase your power and earn rewards.

The Killstreak system changes the way you play across every activity in Diablo IV.

  • Slaughter your enemies in quick succession to begin your Killstreak,
    • As your killstreak begins, a pop-up will start tracking your kill count.
  • Once the Killstreak begins, there’ll be a short period of time before your Killstreak begins to deplete.
  • Continue your Killstreak with merciless pace:
    • Refresh your Killstreak timer with additional kills, direct damage, or on initial damage-over-time application.

Killstreaks are marked by five distinct tiers based off current streak’s total:

  • Killstreak
  • Carnage
  • Devastation
  • Bloodbath
  • Massacre

When the timer bar fully depletes, the Killstreak is over.

  • Experience and seasonal reputation are gained at the end of a Killstreak.
  • The amount of Experience and seasonal reputation gained are based on the total number of monsters slain during the Killstreak, with a bonus based on the Killstreak Tier reached.
    • Note: seasonal reputation will not be present in the PTR.
  • If you should perish while in a Killstreak, it will immediately end without rewards.

Back to Top

Rain Crimson with Bloodied Items

Bloodied Items are a new Item Quality you can harness in combination with your Killstreaks to heighten the bloodshed.

Bloodied Items have affixes which scale in power based off your current Killstreak Tier.

  • Any item that can drop can potentially appear as Bloodied.
  • This Item Quality tag is non-exclusive, and an item can be both Ancestral and Bloodied.

Bloodied Affixes come in three categories:

  • Rampage:
    • Increase in power based off current Killstreak Tier
    • Applies to Armor
    • Ex: Killstreak: 7%[+] Move Speed per Killstreak Tier in your Killstreak
  • Feast:
    • Apply Combat bonuses based off total kills in your current Killstreak
    • Applies to Weapons
    • Ex: Every 40 Kills in your Killstreak, reset 1 random Cooldown
    • These bonuses are constant and are not tied to Killstreak Tier
  • Hunger:
    • Customizes reward offerings, which scale with Killstreak Tiers
    • Ex: Elite kills will drop Runes more frequently
    • Applies to Jewelry

As with other Affixes, Bloodied Affixes stack their effects.

Back to Top

Unlock Slaughter with Bloodied Sigils

Evoke the power of the Burning Hells and set a fearsome combatant on your trail. Bloodied Sigils unlock your ability to increase the heat and increase the ferocity of gameplay while rewarding you handsomely for this increased effort.

  • Nightmare Dungeons, Infernal Hordes, and Lair Bosses each have Bloodied Sigils.
  • These potent Sigils only become available once you reach Torment I.

Bloodied Sigils

  • Each Bloodied Sigil carries a Bloodied Affix, Relentless Butcher. The infamous purveyor of human charcuterie hunts you endlessly, hounding your every move. Should you manage to fell the Butcher, he will immediately return. He will never cease!
  • This does not replace the existing chance to have Butcher spawns, there is the chance to fight both Butchers simultaneously.
  • Expect the activity in the Bloodied Sigil to be around a Torment Tier higher in difficulty than your current Torment Tier.

Bloodied Sigils reward this significant challenge with guaranteed drops of Bloodied Items.

Back to Top

New Unique Items

Wield these tools of demonic dismemberment to beat back the Butcher and continue your slaughter.

Blood-Mad Idol—Unique Amulet

Affixes:

  • 51- 65 All Stats
  • 8.3-10% Attack Speed
  • 7-8% Critical Strike Chance
  • 17.5-31.5% Damage Reduction while Injured

Power:

  • You are always Berserking but take 200%[x] increased damage as Burning over 8 seconds. While Burning, Berserking grants an additional 75-125% increased damage.

Useable by: All Classes

Wendigo Brand—Unique Ring

Affixes:

  • 424-457 Life
  • 855-1086 Life Regen
  • 146-159 Life on Hit
  • 441-490 Physical Resistance

Power:

  • Every 15 kills in the last 30-60 seconds increases your damage dealt by 2%, and Maximum Health by 1%.

Useable by: All Classes

Rustbitten Dirk—Unique Dagger

Affixes:

  • 51-65 All Stats
  • 424-457 Life
  • 8.3-10% Attack Speed
  • 40-50% Vulnerable Damage

Power:

  • Deal 50-100% increased damage to isolated enemies.

Useable by: Sorcerer, Druid, Rogue, Necromancer

Wyrdskin—Unique Gloves

Affixes:

  • 424-457 Life
  • 1-2 Ranks to Core Skills
  • 7-8% Critical Strike Chance
  • 8.3-10% Attack Speed

Power:

  • Attacks apply Vulnerable to Distant Enemies, and Weakened to Close Enemies. Deal 10-30% increased damage to Enemies that are both Vulnerable and Weakened.

Useable by: All Classes

Thousand-Eye Reaver—Unique One-Handed Axe

Affixes:

  • 424-457 Life
  • 7-8% Critical Strike Chance
  • 36.5-50% Movement Speed on Elite Kill
  • Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal 900-2,400 Physical Damage

Power:

  • Moving grants Ferocity, and Maximum Ferocity is increased by 1-3. Ferocity also increases Movement Speed by 4-8% per stack.

Useable by: Barbarian, Druid, Necromancer, Paladin

Back to Top

Features Offered for Testing

We will have servers for PTR in our largest regions: North America, Europe, Korea and Japan, South America, and Australia. Use the PTR Boost NPC in major cities to aid you in the Public Test Realm.

PTR Boost

Similar to our previous Public Test Realms, the trusty PTR Vendor—Mrak—will be available through the duration of the PTR. You can find our hot-footed friend next to the main Waypoint in major cities. Mrak has received some substantial upgrades, now offering segmented boosts if you want to focus on a specific item for testing.

Additionally, when your Account is copied for the PTR, your character names will no longer be changed to ‘default.’

The following items are available through the PTR Boosts. Anything highlighted in blue has been updated since the last PTR:

Crafting & Materials

  • Grant Gold
  • Grant Obols
  • Grant All Materials
  • Unlock Masterworking
  • Grant All Temper Manuals
  • Grant Lair Keys
  • Grant Tributes
  • Grant Infernal Compasses
  • Grant Nightmare Escalation Sigils

Equipment

  • Grant All Runes
  • Max All Aspects
  • Grant Random Legendaries*
  • Grant All Uniques*

Note: To receive Helms and Amulets from the PTR Boost, you must be at least Level 7 and Level 15 respectively. Please use one of the level boosts to level past this point to receive these specific items.*

Paragon

  • Grant All Glyphs
  • Max All Glyphs

Progression

  • Complete Campaign & All Strongholds (Unlocks Whispers and the Artificer’s Obelisk)
  • Set Level to 50
  • Set Level to 60
  • Unlock All Waypoints & Reveal Map
  • Unlock All Torment Tiers
  • Set Paragon to Level 200

Seasonal

  • Grant Bloodied Items
  • Grant Seasonal Activity Keys (Bloodied Sigils)

Back to Top

How to Provide Feedback

Your feedback on the changes you will see and experience in the PTR is important to us and is vital in ensuring that Season 12 is the best it can be when it goes live in Diablo IV. If you participate in the PTR, please let us know what you think!

You can provide feedback through the in-game feedback tool of the Diablo IV PTR forums. Pressing the ESC key in the in-game menu will bring up the Report a Bug menu. You can select the dropdown filter and select the in-game feedback tool to provide feedback without leaving the game.

Back to Top

How to Install the PTR

Here are the steps to join the PTR:

  • Open the Blizzard Battle.net App and select Diablo IV from your Games list.
  • In the selector above the Play button, there is a game version drop down menu.
    • Select the Public Test Realm option
  • Click Install to Install the PTR client. This becomes a Play button when ready.
  • Click Play to log in to the PTR, and select any of the available Test Servers.
  • Create a new test character.
    • Note: Create a Seasonal Character for any testing related to the Seasonal themes.
  • Enter the game and test the 2.6.0 PTR!

If you’re a PC Game Pass or Game Pass Ultimate user, you’ll be able to access the PTR through the same flow as other Battle.net users. Access the Battle.net client through the Xbox App, then continue to access the PTR through Battle.net.

Back to Top

2.6.0 PTR Patch Notes

2.6.0 PTR Build #70465 (PC Only)—February 3, 2026

Expansion

Balance Updates

Paladin

Skills

Holy Light Aura

  • The tooltip now clarifies that it gains damage from attack speed.

Sanctify

  • Damage now remains at 90% when selecting the upgrade.

Conviction

  • Adjusted Rank Up description in tooltip to reflect that the attack speed maximum is increased and not Resolve maximum.

Defiance

  • Increased the damage-over-time tick rate of Rite of Prayer from 2 seconds to 1 second.
  • Adjusted the tooltip to clarify Rite of Prayer works by healing yourself as well.

Heaven's Fury

  • Triplicate base damage increased from 36% to 56%.

Word of Sacrifice (Rally Enhancement)

  • Health cost increased from 15% to 35%.
  • Added a duration indicator and UI number to the Rally icon for this variant.

Pronouncement of Heaven (Spear of Heavens Enhancement)

  • Previous: Spear of the Heavens' first spear gains a permanent Judgement mark and remains on the battlefield, dealing x% damage per second for 8 seconds.
  • Now: Spear of the Heaven's gains 3 initial spears that deal x% damage per second for 12 seconds. These spears can be marked with Judgement.

Passives

Path of the Penitent

  • Damage increased from 10% to 12% per stack.

Unique Items

Dawnfire

  • Updated the tooltip to indicate that the aura around the player changes size.
  • Activating Holy Light now refreshes the duration.
  • Chance for Holy Light aura to deal double damage increased to the higher value for Paladin unique items.
  • Buff duration increased from 15 to 20 seconds.
  • Added a buff number and duration indicator to the Holy Light aura icon.
  • Adjusted the tooltip to show its increased burn area per stack.

Sunbrand

  • Damage increased from 30-50% to 60-100%.

Sundered Night

  • Anointing passive affix replaced with +2-4 ranks to Aura Skills.

Tempering

Holy Light Aura Potency

  • Amount granted doubled.

Paragon

Castle

  • Previous: You deal increased damage equal to 1.8% of your Armor.
  • Now: You deal increased damage equal to 125% of your Damage Reduction granted from Armor.

Spiritborn

In-Fighter Legendary Paragon Node

  • Bonus damage increased from 30%[x] to 45%[x].

Bitter Medicine Legendary Paragon Node

  • Poisoning damage bonus increased from 60%[x] to 80%[x].

Drive Legendary Node

  • Duration reduced from 10 to 5 seconds.
  • Maximum stacks increased from 10 to 20.
  • Updated the tooltip to clarify that the buff does not refresh while at maximum stacks.

Bug Fixes

Paladin

Skill Tree

  • Fixed an issue where Zenith's second cast counted towards casting an ultimate skill for the Zan rune.
  • Fixed an issue where the Sunder upgrade for Zenith only dealt 10% of the intended damage.
  • Fixed an issue where Consecrate would not properly apply Weakened.
  • Fixed an issue where the Armor while in Arbiter form temper did not update if new values were gained or lost while in Arbiter form.
  • Fixed an issue where Judgement marks could rarely apply to destructible objects in the environment.
  • Fixed an issue where Judgement dealt damage as if it always hit one additional target.

Developer’s Note: This fix will be relatively unnoticeable when you’re getting procs from many judgment explosions in a short window, but greatly reduces single explosions.

  • Fixed an issue where Judgement Day's bonus was stacking multiplicatively rather than additively.
  • Fixed an issue where Holy Light Aura would have a delay before it was granted to allies.
  • Fixed an issue where NPC allies within Holy Light aura dealt damage at a far greater rate than intended.
  • Fixed an issue where Fanaticism would snapshot its stats the first time the buff was added.
  • Fixed an issue where the Rite of Prayer upgrade for Defiance Aura caused Resolve to be gained per ally it affected, rather than if at least one ally was affected.
  • Fixed an issue where Thorns bonus from Defiance Aura would not increase with ranks immediately after upgrading the skill.
  • Fixed an issue with Defiance Aura's Active power not granting the full bonuses from Thorns on its attacks.
  • Fixed an issue with Retribution where it wasn't granting the full bonuses from Thorns on its attacks.
  • Fixed an issue with Blessed Shield's Shield of Retribution where it wasn't granting the full bonuses from Thorns on its attacks.
  • Fixed an issue with Fortress' Rampart of Thorns where it wasn't granting the full bonuses from Thorns on its attacks.
  • Fixed an issue where Aegis' Impunity was not granting its Thorns bonus.
  • Fixed an issue where the player would sometimes not dash when using Divine Lance.
  • Fixed an issues where the Juggernaut Oath was granting all skill damage rather than Juggernaut skill damage.
  • Fixed an issue where pressing Falling Star twice in rapid succession would queue a second cast before the first cast completed.

Paragon

  • Fixed an issue where Castle Legendary node would snapshot the values it gains from Armor in some cases.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Law glyph to grant its additive bonus to base damage rather than the additive bonus for Judgement.
  • Fixed an issue where the Preacher paragon node scaled with weapon speed rather than bonus attack speed.

Items

  • Fixed an issue where Aspect of the Disciple would not properly apply Weakened.
  • Fixed an issue where some skills could stack Apogeic Furor more than once per Ultimate cast.

Developer’s Note: Recasted Ultimates will grant one stack on the first Cast of the sequence. Ultimates with charges will grant one stack per Cast.

  • Fixed an issue where both Aspect of the Golden Hour and Aspect of the Judicator were granting base damage rather than multiplicative bonus damage.
  • Fixed an issue where the damage bonus from Bastion of Sir Matthias was being applied to base damage.
  • Fixed an issue where Light's Rebuke and Sunbrand were granting the incorrect amount of Strength and Maximum Life.
  • Fixed an issue where allies had the visual fire aura around them when Dawnfire was equipped.
  • Fixed an issue where the Holy Light Aura granted by Dawnfire would change the rate that NPC allies dealt their damage.
  • Fixed an issue where a player with affixes that reduce Evade’s cooldown with attacks allowed Argent Veil to spawn infinite Core skills.
  • Fixed various other Legendary Aspects and Unique items that were applying damage improperly, granting less bonus than intended.
  • Fixed an issue where Arbiter Wing Strikes double damage tempered affix would snapshot after the effect happened once.
  • Fixed an issue where Judgement of Auriel's damage reduction bonus was not being doubled.
  • Fixed an issue where Judgement of Auriel activated on all versions of Arbiter form's activation.

UI & UX

  • Fixed an issue where Holy Light Aura's Rite of Submission tooltip did not properly explain its effect.

Developer’s Note: This skill stuns enemies it hits, and then deals a burst of damage in an area if the stunned enemy is killed during the duration.

  • Fixed an issue where damage lowered on the tooltip for Sanctify.

Developer’s Note: A compensatory buff for Paladin was implemented for this, see above.

  • Fixed an issue where the tooltip for the Atonement Upgrade for Condemn Atonement didn't display its increased damage per rank.
  • Fixed an issue where tempering for Block Chance didn't display the exact value that would be gained.
  • Fixed an issue where Herald of Zakarum's tooltip was incorrectly displaying a multiplicative value.
  • Fixed multiple issues when using the Keyword search in Paladin's Skill Tree.
  • Fixed multiple issues where tooltips and descriptions weren't accurate or missing information.

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed an issue that caused the Spiritborn Revealing Legendary paragon node to gain more than the intended double bonus when hitting Crowd Controlled enemies.

Base Game

Game Updates

New Uniques

  • All New Items this Season are dropped by the new Butcher Lair Boss.

All Classes

Blood-Mad Idol (Unique Amulet)

  • Affixes:
    • 51-65 All Stats
    • 8.3-10% Attack Speed
    • 7-8% Critical Strike Chance
    • 17.5-31.5% Damage Reduction while Injured
  • Unique Power:
    • You are always Berserking but take 200%[x] increased damage as Burning over 8 seconds. While Burning, Berserking grants an additional 75-125% increased damage.

Wendigo Brand (Unique Ring)

  • Affixes:
    • 424-457 Life
    • 855-1,086 Life Regen
    • 146-159 Life on Hit
    • 441-490 Physical Resistance
  • Power:
    • Attacks apply Vulnerable to Distant Enemies, and Weakened to Close Enemies. Deal 10-30% increased damage to Enemies that are both Vulnerable and Weakened.
  • Useable by: All Classes

Class-Restricted Uniques

Rustbitten Dirk (Unique Dagger)

  • Affixes:
    • 51-65 All Stats
    • 424-457 Life
    • 8.3-10% Attack Speed
    • 40-50% Vulnerable Damage
  • Power:
    • Deal 50-100% increased damage to isolated enemies.
  • Useable by: Sorcerer, Druid, Rogue, Necromancer

Thousand-Eye Reaver (Unique One-Handed Axe)

  • Affixes:
    • 424-457 Life
    • 7-8% Critical Strike Chance
    • 36.5-50% Movement Speed on Elite Kill
    • Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal 900-2,400 Physical Damage
  • Power:
    • Moving grants Ferocity, and Maximum Ferocity is increased by 1-3. Ferocity also increases Movement Speed by 4-8% per stack.
  • Useable by: Barbarian, Druid, Necromancer, Paladin

Balance Updates

Barbarian

Paragon

Weapons Master

  • Fury gain reduced from 12 to 4.
  • Damage bonus against Injured and Healthy increased from 45%[x] to 75%[x].

Warbringer

  • Previous: For every 300 Fury you spend, gain 10% of your Maximum Life as Fortify.
  • Now: After spending 300 Fury, gain 2% of your Maximum Life as Fortify. Deal 45%[x] increased damage while Fortified.

Hemorrhage

  • Damage bonus increased from 60%[x] to 75%[x].

Druid

Paragon

Lust for Carnage

  • Damage bonus increased from 50%[x] to 70%[x].

Thunderstruck

  • Previous: Storm Skills deal increased damage equal to 20%[x] of your Damage vs Close and Damage vs Distant bonuses, up to 60%[x].
  • Now: Storm Skills deal 60%[x] increased damage, and 15%[+] chance to Critically Strike.

Untamed

  • Duration increased from 5 to 10 seconds.

Guzzler Glyph

  • Capped at 20% increased damage and Potion Healing.

Necromancer

Paragon

Blood Begets Blood

  • Damage bonus increased from 10% to 15%, and maximum bonus increased from 50%[x] to 60%[x].
  • Duration increased from 5 to 10 seconds.

Flesh-Eater

  • Previous: Consuming 3 Corpses grants 40%[x] increased damage for 6 seconds.
  • Now: Consuming a Corpse grants 60%[x] increased damage for 8 seconds.

Scent of Death

  • Critical Strike Damage bonus increased from 30%[x] to 45%[x].

Bloodbath

  • Previous: Deal 40%[x] increased Overpower damage. After Overpowering, you deal 25%[x] increased Blood Skill damage for 5 seconds.
  • Now: Deal 20%[x] increased Overpower damage. After Overpowering, you deal 50%[x] increased Physical damage for 5 seconds.

Wither

  • Damage bonus increased from 300%[x] to 400%[x].

Frailty

  • Previous: Cursed enemies take 10%[x] increased damage from you and your Minions. This bonus is increased by 10%[x] each second they are Cursed, up to 40%[x].
  • Now: Deal 50%[x] increased damage to Cursed enemies.

Imbiber Glyph

  • Capped at 20% increased damage and Potion Healing.

Rogue

Paragon

Tricks of the Trade

  • Damage bonus increased from 50%[x] to 60%[x].

Deadly Ambush

  • Damage bonus increased from 50%[x] to 60%[x].

Cheap Shot

  • Damage bonus increased from 30%[x] to 40%[x].

Sorcerer

Paragon

Burning Instinct

  • Previous: Your Burning damage is increased by 20%[x] of your Damage with Fire Bonus, plus 2%[x] for every 30 Intelligence you have, up to 90%[x].
  • Now: Deal 90%[x] increased Burning damage.

Frigid Fate

  • Previous: You deal bonus damage to Vulnerable enemies equal to 20%[x] of the total amount of your Bonus Damage with Cold, up to a maximum of 60%[x].
  • Now: Deal 60%[x] bonus damage to Vulnerable enemies.

Elemental Summoner

  • Previous: Your Conjuration Skills have a 10%[x] reduced Cooldown or Mana cost. They also deal bonus damage equal to 10%[x] of the total amount of your Bonus Damage with Fire, Lightning, and Cold, up to 60%[x].
  • Now: Your Conjuration Skills have a 20%[x] reduced Cooldown or Mana cost. Casting a Conjuration Skill increases your damage with their element by 50%[x] for 6 seconds.

The Tower

  • New monster types can now be encountered in the Tower.
  • New tilesets and art assets have been added for the Tower.

Miscellaneous

  • How fast you complete a traversal now scales with movement speed, including mount speed for traversals that can be jumped over while mounted.
  • Using a traversal now resets your Mount cooldown.
  • Potion cooldown is no longer different when in the Fields of Hatred.
  • Masterworked Greater Affixes now have their own icon to make them stand out.
  • The Legendary Monster affix now only appears in Expert Difficulty and higher.
  • The Unique Monster affix now only appears in Penitent Difficulty and higher.
  • Added a new Hide Weapon option in the Wardrobe, allowing players to conceal sheathed weapon for a cleaner, more personalized appearance.
  • Updated DLSS Super Resolution presets, taking advantage of DLSS 4.5 features when applicable. This improves image quality when using Ultra Performance, Performance, and DLAA quality modes.

Bug Fixes

Accessibility

  • Fixed an issue where the Screen Reader only read the quantity of rewards from Season Rank, but not what the rewards themselves are.
  • Fixed an issue where the Screen Reader did not read out Player Names when on the Social screen when using a Controller.
  • Fixed an issue where the Screen Reader would malfunction in the Season Rank window if the player was attacked.

The Tower

  • Fixed an issue where the Mastery Goblin would persist after the progress bar filled.
  • Fixed an issue where there was a chance to spawn into a tower layout where the player could damage monsters without leaving the circle.
  • Fixed an issue where the Sower of Decay Guardian boss could turn invisible if hit by their own skill.

Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where the Unstoppable buff granted by Grizzly Rage could randomly drop off.
  • Fixed an issue where Aspect of Fel Gluttony would not properly hit twice with the Necromancer Golem hits twice affix.
  • Fixed an issue where Golems spawned from Gravebloom were not properly respawning.
  • Fixed an issue where Trickster's Aspect would cause Death Trap to spawn twice as many stun grenades as intended.
  • Fixed an issue where Death Trap's Stun grenades spawned from Tricksters Aspect would spawn on the player rather than where Death Trap was Cast.
  • Fixed an issue with Beastfall Boots where the amount of resource gained was not reflected in the HUD and the stats window.
  • Fixed an issue where Shields could drop with a Barrier Generation affix.
  • Fixed an issue where summoning Bartuc in Infernal Hordes with exactly 666 Aether caused Bartuc to spawn but no Aether would be consumed and Bartuc would drop no loot. (Bartuc was clearly afraid of Diablo’s signature number).
  • Fixed an issue where Esadora's Overflowing Cameo would not grant the bonus skill ranks from temporary skill rank bonuses.
  • Fixed an issue where the Andariel encounter could continue longer than expected if her health was reduced to zero during the phase transition.

User Interface and User Experience

  • Fixed an issue where the different color added to affixes after adding Item Quality was also applied to inherent affixes, which are not affected by Quality upgrades.
  • Fixed an issue where multiplicative versions of Damage to Crowd Controlled targets were not displaying in the stats window.
  • Fixed an issue where clicking the View on Map button from Season Rank screen wouldn't function while inside a dungeon.
  • Fixed an issue where the Armory could become inaccessible in certain situations.
  • Fixed multiple issues when navigating the player Profile tab on Controller.
  • Fixed multiple instances of Placeholder or missing texts or images.
  • Fixed multiple instances where the tooltip and codex descriptions for some aspects were inconsistent.

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed an issue where both the player and any followers would have invisible weapons after dismounting.
  • Fixed an issue where the visions of Liltih and Vhenard reappeared after fading during the Storming the Gates quest.
  • Fixed an issue where the Whisper Cache Collection of Rings only dropped one Ring. It’s a strange fate that we should suffer over such a little thing.
  • Fixed an issue where some Whisper Caches didn't drop lair boss summoning materials as expected.
  • Fixed an issue where using a Raven of the Tree did not fulfill the requirements for the Claim a reward from the Tree of Whispers objective for the Deeds of the Champion quest.
  • Fixed multiple instances where Leave Dungeon didn't function properly.
  • Various performance, stability, visual, and audio improvements.

Though the clergy of the holy caution against the violence of the hateful, it is long past when you used this rage to cleanse Sanctuary of these foul beasts.
—The Diablo IV Team

item.author: Blizzard Entertainment

item.title: Catch Up on the State of Azeroth in our Recap
item.description:
World of Warcraft

Catch Up on the State of Azeroth in our Recap

Blizzard Entertainment

From the roadmaps of what’s ahead for modern World of Warcraft and Classic World of Warcraft, to claiming your own Dark Portal Housing decor item to set up in your own home, we’ve rounded up everything you need to know about the State of Azeroth.

We’re on the cusp of the Midnight expansion launch and all the stories that will be told as we defend Azeroth from the threat the Void presents. Beyond Midnight, players will be able to experience the third and final installment of the World Soul Saga with The Last Titan.

Beyond the looming darkness and perils players will face, there is also the call of home with Housing, offering a place to rest and express themselves creatively. This feature is twenty years in the making and we knew we had to deliver something that could grow and evolve over the years. Players with the Midnight expansion are already delving into this feature with Housing Early Access with the full launch just around the corner.

Introducing Azeroth Interiors

To shine a light on this new feature, we’re bringing in some of the biggest creator names and best builders alike to go head-to-head in a delightful interior design competition! We’re calling up six pairs of prominent creators from around the world to create a concept, execute on their ideas, and produce exemplary player houses worth coming home to.

You don’t have to be a competitor to get in on the fun. Share your own Housing creations on social media by using the hashtag #AzerothInteriors.

Learn more about what’s in store in our previously published article.

WoW Classic and Looking Ahead

Over the past six years, Classic has been an expression of love for the early years of WoW and bringing it to you in a variety of flavors. Between Hardcore, Seasonal, and Progression realms the community has shown us the ongoing potential of Classic are limitless. We take that to heart and we will continue to honor that.

Mists of Pandaria Classic

Today, Mists of Pandaria Classic continues in the original Classic realms with the next major milestone the release of the Escalation update in just a few weeks. It includes a new quest campaign, battleground, scenarios, and more.

Updates for Mists of Pandaria Classic will continue to be released over time as we have with previous expansions—with the Siege of Orgrimmar and the return of Timeless Isle later this year.

Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition

The launch of Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition is on our doorstep. Another round of Illidan taunts and Fel Reaver terror. You’ll play through the chess event in Karazhan, face Magtheridon, and more throughout the year.

Seasonal Titan Reforged Realms Launched in China

We’ve also launched Seasonal Titan Reforged Realms in Classic WoW for players in China. Why? Not only are the audiences between modern and Classic World of Warcraft unique, but so are the players in China. We made those realms for them based on how they play.

This is not all we have cooking up. We can say with confidence all Classic players across the globe have a lot to look forward to. We’ll save that for later.

Our Commitment to You

What is the State of Azeroth? It’s alive in all its forms and we plan to keep it that way with your help and guidance as we listen to your feedback and act on it. We’ll soon be launching surveys within the game to get your thoughts and feedback. We are committed to listening to you and aim to keep proving our dedication to this ideal. We want to continue providing you with the space, place, and tools to play the way you want to play and live how you want to live in Azeroth. That’s our Northstar.

We want our humble universe to be go to when you have free time, when you need to recharge alongside your friends and family after a long day, or when you need an escape. Let off steam by conquering a boss, roleplaying, now decorating, transmogging, PvPing, exploring, and more. A fantasy home in every sense. Where strangers become friends and friends become neighbors.

Find Your People

We have a plan for those of you looking to find your people. Those players who enjoy WoW the same way you do. We’re calling it the WoW Ambassador Program. It’s all about the community helping the community. It’s less about us and more about you. It’s a bit of an experiment to help connect you with players and communities that are filled with others who play how you play—or how you want to play. These Ambassadors are helpful friends within our own WoW community. Learn more about the program in our article.

New Charity Pet Pack for Habitat for Humanity

As you know, community is our mainstay and in the era of Housing, we wanted to do what we can to support those who need more than pixels when it comes to having a place to live. This year we’re excited to be partnering with Habitat for Humanity with a charity pet pack that we hope, with your support, will help provide safety and shelter to families in need of an affordable home. Habitat for Humanity has helped more than sixty-five million people globally.

 This charity pet pack includes the adorable Roofus who will be available in both modern World of Warcraft and Classic WoW. Roofus loves to build—something you’ll see in action if he’s left idle for too long. Those of you who play modern WoW will also get a dog house, a bowl, and a bed.

We’re incredibly excited to be supporting Habitat for Humanity this year and will have more information to share about how you can bring Roofus home soon.

A Thank You!

As always, you are our heroes, our heartbeat, and our gratitude is everlasting.

Thank you for your continued passion, for the time you’ve put into this world, and for your boundless creativity. It has been amazing seeing so many jump into Housing over the last couple of months. On behalf of everyone who had any part in bringing Housing to life, we are in awe of what you’ve already created. We knew you’d make incredible homes, but the community response has blown away our expectations. There is no World of Warcraft without you the community.

We are honored to be a part of this world and humbled to be the caretakers of something that has remained so special and important to so many people for so long.

The Current and Future World of Warcraft

We want to share a bit of what we’re up to for World of Warcraft in terms of the right now, present content, the fast-approaching launch of Midnight, and a small peek at some of the bigger things we have planned for 2026. We aren’t able to get into all the details just yet as many of these plans involve story spoilers and we want to hold on to some surprises to share later. There’s still a lot to look forward to for all residents of Azeroth in the year ahead.

It’s Nearly Midnight

We’re almost a month away from Midnight launch and the development team is hard at work fixing bugs, refining features, and getting the expansion ready for players to dive into in March. Between now and the launch of the expansion, there’s still plenty to see and do in WoW today.

The Midnight Pre-Expansion Update

Twilight Ascension Pre-Expansion Event

The Twilight Ascension pre-expansion event is live now and runs through to the launch of Midnight on March 2. This is where the stakes start to crystallize and the threat we face begins to take shape. It’s also where the Void makes itself felt in Azeroth. This is a repeatable event in which players join Umbric and Grand Magister Rommath to keep the Twilight’s Blade cult at bay.

Players take up World Quests and defeat rare enemies to disrupt the rituals of the Twilight’s Blade cult as well as earn event currency to use to purchase limited-time rewards such as armor sets, pets, a mount, and more. Players will also be able to collect new Housing decor to help furnish their home in Azeroth. Learn more about the event in our previously published article.

Demon Hunter Devourer Specialization and Void Elf Demon Hunters

Also in the pre-expansion content update, players can take up a new Void-themed ranged Devourer specialization. Void Elf Demon Hunters can be unlocked after a short questline. Learn more in our previously published article.

Systems Updates

Some of the baseline system improvements and updates have also gone live including an updated transmog system that includes situational outfit swapping, an improved user interface (UI), and slot-based transmog so that you don’t have to re-transmog every time you get an upgrade.

Training Grounds

For players new to PvP, you can learn the ropes in the training grounds against smarter game-controlled opponents in the Arathi Basin, Silvershard Mines, and Battle for Gilneas battlegrounds.

Winds of Mysterious Fortune

A limited-time event, reputation gains and experience gains are boosted for players below level 80, it’s a great way to get caught up to speed before the Midnight release whether you’re leveling an alternate character to join the fray or fast-tracking some reputation-based Housing decor items that you’ve been aiming to add to your collection. Learn more in our article.

Dark Portal Housing Decor Item

For a limited time, we’re granting a Dark Portal Housing decor item for all players with an active World of Warcraft subscription or Game Time who log in between now and Midnight expansion launch.  

Make Your Stand During the Welcome Back Weekend

From January 29 through February 1, we're giving all players with inactive World of Warcraft® accounts full access to return to the game and all your characters without a subscription. Explore the World of Warcraft base game up to level 80 including all level-up content, the pre-launch events, the recent system updates in the pre-expansion content update, the completely overhauled returning player experience, and more than twenty years of Azeroth’s world and story.

We’re excited for the Midnight expansion and we want to make it easy for you to check it all out for yourself. Learn more about the Welcome Back Weekend in our news article.

Midnight Expansion

  • Increased Level Cap: The level cap in Midnight is increasing to level 90, and players will level through four new and reimagined zones full of new questing content of both campaign chapters as well as local stories with additional chapters waiting for you at maximum level.
  • Eight New Dungeons: The expansion also introduces eight new dungeons, eleven new Delves and a new Delve companion, Valeera Sanguinar.
  • Prey System: The new Prey System adds a new layer of depth and challenge to your gameplay.
  • Slayers Rise PvP: A new PvP feature is arriving in Midnight with the Epic Battleground, Slayer’s Rise, which also exists as an outdoor world space for those who want to take part in world PvP in War Mode.
  • Arcantina: Spend time in the Arcantina, a mystical tavern where you can rub elbows with some big names in WoW lore, learn more about them, and complete quests on their behalf.

A couple of weeks after the launch of the expansion, Midnight Season One begins, pulling the story forward through a host of new content.

  • The Voidspire Raid: This six-boss raid is the beginning of the capstone for the story we’re telling at the start of Midnight.
  • The Dreamrift Raid: A smaller one boss raid encounter.
  • Four New World Bosses
  • Updated Mythic+ Dungeon Pool: Four dungeons will be new Midnight dungeons and four will be four updated legacy dungeons.
  • New Delves Season
  • New PvP Season

 Shortly after the start of Season One, we’ll introduce a third raid zone with two bosses in The March on Quel’Danas. This new raid will cap off the initial chapter of the Midnight story, bringing us closer to what will come next.

The addition of Story Mode to World of Warcraft has made it so that any player can experience these moments for themselves. We want to continue to lean in, giving you ways to experience the story of Azeroth no matter how you choose to play.  Whether you want to jump in and tackle raids, take on Delves, or just hang out in the Arcantina and chat. Our goal is to give you lots to do and plenty of options to select from.

We can’t wait to see how you choose to adventure across the unfolding story of Midnight. Midnight Early Access begins February 26 at 3:00 pm PST worldwide.

Housing Updates

We have been overwhelmed by your creativity and ingenuity during Housing Early Access, along with your feedback. We want you to help us build this feature together. We want to hear more of what you’re interested in, more of what’s working, and what’s not working. Your feedback is directly informing the decisions we make. You’ve already seen some of the quality-of-life improvements go live over the last couple of months, but we’re keeping a close eye on Housing to continually improve the feature from every angle. Whether we’re talking about economy adjustments, UI updates, or all new functionalities.

We want to keep finding opportunities to support the creative expression that you invent, such as making it easier to float your house as an example. We already have a couple of things in mind. We’ve heard from many in the community that your cozy creation doesn’t feel complete without the ability for some of your companion pets to wander around your home.  We want to offer this ability to do this along with showcasing more of your cosmetic collections in general such as being able to hitch a couple of your favorite mounts up in your yard outdoors. We’re working on delivering this as well.

We’ve also seen and heard that as you’re expressing your boundless creativity, you want to be able to move creations in their entirety—such as a grand piano made of various decor items—to a new spot in your home without having to deconstruct it. We want to make it so that you can select multiple pieces and move them all together along with the ability to copy and paste.

As you’re browsing other players Housing designs, we’ve heard that you would like a way to copy and import their looks as a starting point for your own creations, or maybe you have created something you would like to share with others. To that end, we’re working on import and export codes for easy sharing and exchanging your house designs.

We’re also continuing to increase indoor and outdoor decor budgets as we learn more about technical limits of the system along with simply wanting to make sure we’re providing opportunities for progression as you level up your house.

This is only some of what we’re working on with an eye on some bigger things for Housing as well. We’re paying attention to how Endeavors are working, how they enliven Neighborhoods, and how players interact with them, so that we can continue to support the things you want to see from the feature.

This is just the ground floor for Housing in World of Warcraft. This is the foundation of a feature that we want to be a reflection of your life and times in Azeroth and we’re serious about expanding it and improving it alongside you, the player, in the years to come.

Thank you for your passion and feedback so far. Keep telling us what you want from Housing and we will keep listening and keep it coming.

Beyond Midnight

We have a few things to share with you beyond the launch of Midnight beginning with a few specific plans and then getting a bit vaguer as we move into the later part of the year.

12.0.5

Shortly after the launch of Midnight, patch 12.0.5 will arrive on the Public Test Realm (PTR). This update finds us in the aftermath of the Season One raids.

Void Assaults

The threat of Xal’atath has yet to be resolved, so we’re going to see Void Assaults begin to appear across the outdoor world. These will bring us new enemies to fight, new reasons to rally to defend Azeroth, and new rewards along the way.

Prop Hunt

On the lighter side, we’ll be adding a prop hunt-inspired event as a small diversion from the battle between the Light and the Void. In this event, you’re going to queue up to join a team of five to face off against another small team of five in a location such as Silvermoon City. One team will use illusion to disguise themselves as innocuous props to hide within the environment. The other team will try to seek them out. You might not defeat the Void and save Azeroth by taking part in this event, but it’s a great way to find a bit of fun in the face of the ever present and growing threat the Void presents.

12.0.7

Our next small update brings a further escalation of Void Assaults and introduces a one boss raid with Sporefall. We’re excited to move away from the idea that raids need to be massive twice a year updates. We want to lean more into the flexibility of matching the content we offer to the ongoing narrative and find opportunities to tell stories of different shapes and sizes.

12.1

This brings us to our first major Midnight content update. It will arrive with a new zone with maximum level content, new raid, and a new season with an updated Mythic+ dungeon Pool, new PvP and Delves rewards, and continued refinements you’d expect from a major content update in World of Warcraft.

The update will also bring with it an overhaul of the Friends system, making it easier to keep up with friends you have and make new friends along the way.

12.1.5

We’re introducing a new content type. To support the passionate community around Delves, we want to add more flexibility and experimentation. For those who love Delve gameplay but want something more than the bite sized experiences that are currently offered, we’re adding a new feature that we’re currently calling Labyrinths.

These are inspired by mega-dungeons. They are large sprawling experiences you can tackle all at once or a bit at a time depending on your own schedule. They will have a different form and reward structure than are currently available in Delves but retain the core elements of exploring and besting foes alongside your Delve companion.

In 12.1.5, we’re also planning another small one boss raid encounter. Unlike the raid in 12. 0.7, which is more of a standalone experience, this raid will be a continuation of the narrative in Midnight. It will serve as a bridge and set the stage for the next major update the following year.

Later in the year, we’ll also have a new stand-alone event from the same wizards who brought you game modes like Plunderstorm or Remix. We’ll share more about this mode later and it will exist alongside the core World of Warcraft game.

This is all accompanied by the steady flow of content that the community is used to seeing such as holiday updates, events like Turbulent Timeways, and much more.

Looking Forward

There’s much more to come in Midnight and World of Warcraft as a whole and we can’t wait for you to see it. BlizzCon is arriving in just under eight months and it’s going to be one for the ages. We hope to see you there so that we can show you more about what we’re thinking for the next twenty years of everything Warcraft. You won’t want to miss it.

Thank you for joining us and thank you for being a part of the journey with us. We know the Void and Xal’atath are dark threats, the stakes are high and the tone of Midnight can be dire. But we also never want to forget that Azeroth is, for all of us, home. It’s a place of light, community, family, and friends. This is a world that can warm the heart of even the Prince of Darkness.

Adventure is calling you home. We’ll see you at BlizzCon 2026 and, of course, in Azeroth.

item.title: Make Your Stand During Welcome Back Weekend
item.description:
World of Warcraft

Make Your Stand During Welcome Back Weekend

Blizzard Entertainment

World of Warcraft®: Midnight™ is nearly here—gather your friends and prepare to embark on a new adventure. From January 29 through February 1*, we're giving all players with inactive World of Warcraft® accounts full access to the game** and all your characters, without a subscription***.

When: January 29 through February 1

Brave adventurers who previously had an active subscription can access all expansions, including The War Within, to play the most recent content—including the Twilight Ascension Pre-Expansion event where you’ll band together to keep the growing Twilight's Blade cult at bay by disrupting their rituals, and defeating rare enemies across the highlands. Read more about the Twilight Ascension Pre-Expansion event from our previously published article.

Also available during Welcome Back Weekend:

  • Harness the Void with the Third Demon Hunter Specialization: Devourer is a new damage-dealing spec for Demon Hunters focuses on delivering new gameplay by using Void magic, features distinct gameplay mechanics, and gains access to the Scarred Hero Talent tree (formerly called Fel Scarred). [Learn More]

  • Get a Glow Up with Transmog Updates: Take your transmog game further with the ability to unlock and save full outfit sets across characters for any occasion. The updated transmog system also provides an additional opportunity for adding more customization and self-expression. You’ll be able to unlock and save dozens of outfits. Whether you’re fighting in a dungeon or exploring a new area, you’ll be able to dress for the moment. [Learn More]

  • Winds of Mysterious Fortune Are Gusting: Get satchels chock full of valuable and unique items during the Winds of Mysterious Fortune event and take advantage of the Winds of Mysterious Fortune experience buff. Get ready for the launch of Midnight by leveling up new characters, catching up on your alts, and finishing missed content. [Learn More]

  • WoW®: Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition Pre-Expansion Content is Now Live: Prepare to tread once again through the Dark Portal into the fel-scarred realm of Outland. WoW®: Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition launches on February 5 at 3:00 pm PST globally and is included with a WoW Subscription or Game Time. [Learn More]

  • Access to all Classic Versions of World of Warcraft: Relive nostalgic adventures in Classic Era, WoW Classic progression (currently Mists of Pandaria Classic), Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary, WoW Classic Hardcore, and WoW Classic Season of Discovery.

Rejoin your guild, rally your Warband, and prepare to explore an entirely new world in Azeroth and get ready for Midnight when it launches on March 2, 2026, at 3 pm PST globally.

*Ability to return to WoW without a subscription ends on February 2, at 10:00 am PDT. Player is responsible for any online connection fees.
**Housing Early Access is only available with pre-purchase of any Midnight edition.
***To be eligible for Welcome Back Weekend, a player must have previously had an active subscription. World of Warcraft Game Time not required during Welcome Back Weekend.

item.title: OWCS 2026 - 開幕前ガイド
item.description:
Overwatch 2

OWCS 2026 - 開幕前ガイド

Blizzard Entertainment

より親しみやすく、そして選手もファンもさらなるメリットを享受できる「オーバーウォッチ」eスポーツを目指して、OWCSは2025年にさらなる進化を遂げました。

予選を勝ち残ったチームが各地域のレギュラー・シーズンを戦い、その上位数チームがプレイオフへと進出。その後、各地域のトップチームがオフラインの国際大会へと進出するという大枠はそのままに、NAとEMEAの2地域では、OWCSの大会予選と本大会の昇格/降格をFACEIT Leagueで実施。その結果、OWCSは真の意味で実力のある選手とチームが生き残れる、よりオープンで競技性の高い大会へと昇華しました。

そして、その国際大会も2025年は「Champions Clash」、「Midseason Championship」、「World Finals」とこれまで以上に大規模になり、各大会で白熱の戦いが繰り広げられました。

今年のOWCSでは、より多くの選手に参加の機会を設け、より多くのファンに感動を届けられるよう、新イベントや人気イベントをこの1年間に実施する予定です。

観戦方法、参戦機会ともに広がる今年のOWCS。その詳細をこの記事でご紹介していきます。

目次

  • OWCS 2026年シーズンの詳細

    • Pre-Season Bootcamp

    • OWCS 2026

  • 2026年の大会フォーマット：NA＆EMEA

    • オープン予選

    • Stageフォーマット

    • スケジュール

  • 2026年の大会フォーマット：ASIA

  • 2026年の大会フォーマット：ASIA

  • OWCS 2026パートナー・チーム

  • 配信プラットフォーム＆SNSアカウント

  • おわりに

2026年シーズンの詳細

今年のOWCSには、去年以上にハイレベルな戦いと感動をお届けできるよう、2025年のフォーマットをベースに新イベントを加わえます。 

Pre-Season Bootcamp

去年のOWCSでは地域間のパフォーマンスのギャップが縮まり、初年度以上の激戦が展開されました。この流れをさらに加速させるべく、今年のOWCSでは初の試みとして、プレ・シーズン・イベント「Pre-Season Bootcamp」を開催する予定です。

Stage 1開催前に行われるこのイベントでは、OWCSの全パートナー・チームが韓国のソウルに一堂に会し、今後配信予定のコンテンツや競技用ビルドを使った開幕前テスト、デイリー・スクリム、チーム間コラボレーションを実施。イベントの最後にはトーナメントで、参加チーム全員が相まみえます。このイベントは、各チームの選手やコーチがチームの枠を超えて共同トレーニングやテスト、意見交換に励める機会を設けることを目的としており、このイベントを通じて、参加チームすべてが2026年シーズンに向けた準備を万全に整えられる環境を確立できればと考えています。

Pre-Season Bootcampは2月9日から15日に、ソウルのT1本部にある「T1 Academy」にて行われます。先述のとおり、このイベントではシーズン開幕前の実戦訓練も兼ねたトーナメントを2月13日から16日にかけて、弘大のWDG Studioにて実施する予定です。

参加チーム

Pre-Season Bootcampの参加チームは、全部で11あるNA、EMEA、ASIA、CHINAのOWCSパートナー・チームとJAPANの招待チーム1つ、計12チームで構成されています。

ロスターはStage 1のものと関係なく編成できるので、各チームはBootcampの名が示すとおり、このトーナメントでさまざまなチーム編成を思いのままにテストできます。

OWCSパートナー・チーム（全11チーム）：

  • NA：Team Liquid、Dallas Fuel、Disguised
  • EMEA：Twisted Minds、Virtus Pro、Team Peps
  • ASIA（KOREA）：T1、Team Falcons、Crazy Raccoon
  • CHINA：未定（2チームが参加予定）

招待チーム

  • ASIA（JAPAN）：Varrel

トーナメント

トーナメントはシングル・エリミネーション形式で行われます。また、本トーナメントの地域別の成績や過去のOWCS World Finalsにおける成績に応じて、シードが事前に決まります。配信スケジュールや配信方法などのさらなる詳細は後日お知らせします。

配信

配信、会場設営を含むPre-Season Bootcampの運営全般は、ASIAのeスポーツ・パートナーであるWDGが担当します。本トーナメントの模様はOWCSの公式チャンネルを通じて英語、韓国語、日本語で配信する予定です。

なお、Pre-Season Bootcampトーナメントの会場チケットは、Ticketlink（ https://www.ticketlink.co.kr）にてご購入いただけます。

OWCS 2026

そしてPre-Season Bootcampの後、2026年度OWCSがCHINA、NA、EMEA、ASIAの4地域で本格的に始まります。今年も、各地域の各Stageにて、プレイオフとオフライン大会への出場権、そしてその先にあるOWCSチャンピオンの称号と賞金を賭けた数々の戦いが繰り広げられます。

各Stageの最初には、地域別のオープン予選を実施し、Stage 2と3の開幕時には、昇格/降格トーナメントも開催します。パートナー・チームは自動的にStage 1のレギュラー・シーズンへの出場権を獲得できますが、もしレギュラー・シーズンで成績が振るわなかった場合、その後のStageにて昇格/降格トーナメントへと出場することになり、最悪、レギュラー・シーズンへの出場権を失います。レギュラー・シーズンの上位チームは、地域別のプレイオフへと出場し、その中で上位の成績を残した地域トップのチームが、Stage別に設けられたオフラインの国際大会へと駒を進めます。

フォーマットの詳細

NA/EMEA

オープン予選

NAとEMEAのオープン予選はFACEITで開催され、ここでStage 1のレギュラー・シーズンを戦うチームと新たなパートナー・チームが決まります。パートナー・チームはStage 1に自動で進出できますが、Stage 2とStage 3では他のチームと同様、脱落の可能性もあります。

なお、2026年のオープン予選参加チームの募集はすでに始まっています。腕に自身のあるという同地域にお住まいの方はぜひ、予選にふるってご参加ください。

  • Registration参加登録

    • NAはこちら

    • EMEAはこちら

    • 募集開始：1月20日

    • 募集終了：2月21日

  • 大会形式

    • 2フェーズ・トーナメント（全試合3ラウンド先取）
    • フェーズ1：スイス式トーナメント
    • フェーズ2：ダブル・エリミネーション・トーナメント
    • フェーズ1には誰でも登録できます。フェーズ2には、フェーズ1の上位チームが進出できます
    • 2025年のOWCSとFACEIT League Competitionの上位チームは、フェーズ2から参戦可能です。さらなる詳細は以下のリンクからご確認ください
    • NA：上位2チームがOWCS Stage 1に進出
    • EMEA：上位3チームがOWCS Stage 1に進出

大会や参加資格の詳細は、こちらのページとOWCSルールブックでご確認いただけます。

Stageフォーマット：NA＆EMEA

  • レギュラー・シーズン：
    • 6チームの総当たり戦を数週間にわたって開催
    • 上位4チームがダブル・エリミネーション形式のプレイオフ・トーナメントに進出
    • 上位4チームは次のStageへの出場権を自動的に獲得
    • 下位2チームは次のStageへの出場権を賭けた昇格/降格トーナメントに参加

  • 昇格/降格トーナメント：
    • ステージの合間に開催（NA/EMEAのみ）
    • 4チームによるダブル・エリミネーション形式のトーナメント
    • FACEIT LeagueのMaster Divisionの上位2チームとOWCSの下位2チームが出場
    • 上位2チームがOWCSのレギュラー・シーズンに進出
    • 下位2チームがFACEIT LeagueのMaster Divisionに降格
  • ライブ・イベント：
    • 大会形式とシード権の枠数はStageごとに異なります。こちらに関する詳細は後日お届けする予定です

主要日程

  • Stage 1
    • オープン予選：2月22日、2月23日、3月1日、3月2日
    • レギュラー・シーズン：
      • 第1週：3月22日、23日
      • 第2週：3月29日～30日
      • 第3週：4月5日、6日
    • プレイオフ：4月11日～13日
    • 2026 Champions Clash：5月23日～25日
  • Stage 2
    • 昇格/降格トーナメント：5月31日
    • レギュラー・シーズン：
      • 第1週：6月14日、15日
      • 第2週：6月21日、22日
      • 第3週：6月28日、29日
    • プレイオフ：7月4日～6日
    • 2026 Midseason Championship：7月30日～8月3日
  • Stage 3
    • 昇格/降格トーナメント：8月16日
    • レギュラー・シーズン：
      • 第1週：10月11日、12日
      • 第2週：10月18日、19日
      • 第3週：10月25日、26日
    • プレイオフ：10月31日～11月2日
    • OWCS 2026 World Finals：12月3日～7日

ASIA

オープン予選

ASIAの2026年シーズンも、他の地域と同様にオープン予選から始まります。ASIAの場合、KOREA、JAPAN、PACIFICの3つのサブ・リージョンに属するチームが、Stage 1のレギュラー・シーズンの参加枠を賭けてさまざまな戦いを繰り広げます。2026年度のパートナー・チームはStage 1にこそ自動的に進出できますが、その後のStageでは、パートナー・チームといえども脱落のリスクと無縁ではいられません。

オープン予選は2月21日と22日に開催されます。オープン予選出場者の登録は、2026年2月より、wara.ggにて開始する予定です。

Stageフォーマット：KOREA

確立したeスポーツ文化と激しい競争環境を誇るOWCS ASIAの要、KOREA。

2026年も引き続き、OWCS ASIA最高峰のサブ・リージョンとして、一貫したパフォーマンスや成長を見せることでしょう。

  • レギュラー・シーズン：
  • 9チームによる総当たり戦。上位4チームがシード決定戦に進出し、プレイオフの座を賭けた戦いに挑みます
  • 5位～8位のチームはLCQ（ラスト・チャンス予選）に進出し、シーズン後に開催されるオフライン大会の最後の1枠を賭けて争います
  • 第9位のチームはシーズン敗退です
  • プレイオフ：
  • 6チームによるシングル・エリミネーション・ブラケット
  • 上位4チームがOWCS ASIAのStage 1オンライン大会に進出
Stageフォーマット：JAPAN

競争力とファン・ベースの両面で成長を続けているのが日本ことJAPAN。ASIA最高峰のステージで他のチームと台頭に渡り合える実力を備えるべく、今年はこれまで以上に大きな成長を目指しています。

コミュニティやインフルエンサーが企画した独自のプログラムを通じて発展を遂げているのもJAPANの大きな特徴。今年もこうしたプログラムを通じた新たな才能の発掘や、競技シーンのさらなる発展に注目が集まります。

  • レギュラー・シーズン：
  • 8チームによる総当たり戦
  • 上位4チームが地域プレイオフに進出
  • プレイオフ：
  • 4チームによるシングル・エリミネーション・ブラケット
  • JAPANの上位3チームとPACIFICの上位1チームがOWCS ASIAのStage 1オンライン大会に進出できます。
Stageフォーマット：PACIFIC

オーストラリアなどの南太平洋地域を中心に形成されるPACIFIC。下記の詳細のとおり、今年もPACIFICでは他のサブ・リージョンと同じく激しい戦いが予想されます。

  • レギュラー・シーズン：
  • 6チームによる総当たり戦。
  • 上位4チームが地域プレイオフに進出
  • プレイオフ：
  • 4チームによるシングル・エリミネーション・ブラケット
  • 上位1チームがOWCS ASIAのStage 1オンライン大会に進出できます

主要日程：

  • Stage 1
    • オープン予選：2月28日～3月2日
    • レギュラー・シーズン
      • 第1週：3月17日～23日
      • 第2週：3月24日～30日（OWCS韓国のバイウィーク）
      • 第3週：3月31日～4月6日
      • 第4週：4月7日～13日
      • 第5週：4月14日～20日
    • LCQ&シード決定戦
      • KOREA：4月25日～27日
    • プレイオフ
      • PACIFIC：4月24日
      • JAPAN：4月28日
      • KOREA：5月2日～4日

全体的なフォーマットはStageを通じて変わりません。Stage 2とStage 3に関する詳細は後日お知らせします。

China

去年、OWCSに加わった新地域CHINAでは、その発足以降、白熱の戦いが繰り広げられています。大会形式の一新やパートナー・チームへの参加なども相まって、今年も同地域の戦いは大きく盛り上がることでしょう。

CHINAのさらなる詳細は、こちらのリンクからご確認ください。

Stageフォーマット：CHINA

  • レギュラー・シーズン：
    • 4チームによるダブル・エリミネーション・ブラケット
    • プレイオフ：
    • スイス式トーナメント：
      • 8チームがスイス式トーナメントで競い合います
      • 第7位と8位のチームはシーズン敗退です
    • 総当たり戦：
      • その後、上位6チームが総当たり戦に挑みます
      • 上位4チームがプレイオフに進出できます

主要日程

  • Stage 1
    • オープン予選：2月28日～3月2日、3月7日～9日
    • レギュラー・シーズン
      • 第1週：3月22日、23日
      • 第2週：3月29日、30日
      • 第3週：4月5日、6日
      • 第4週：4月12日、13日
      • 第5週：4月19日、20日
    • プレイオフ：4月26日、27日
  • Stage 2
    • オープン予選：5月9日～11日、5月16日～18日
    • レギュラー・シーズン
      • 第1週：6月7日、8日
      • 第2週：6月14日、15日
      • 第3週：6月20日～22日
      • 第4週：6月27日～29日
    • プレイオフ：7月5日、6日
  • Stage 3
    • オープン予選：8月29日～31日、9月5日～7日
    • レギュラー・シーズン
      • 第1週：10月4日、5日
      • 第2週：10月11日、12日
      • 第3週：10月18日、19日
      • 第4週：10月25日、26日
      • 週5週：10月31日～11月2日
    • プレイオフ：11月8日、9日

2026 OWCS パートナーチーム

また2026年には、OWCSパートナー・プログラムの対象となるチーム数が9から11に増えるうえ、CHINAに参加するチームも公式パートナー・プログラムに加わります。以下に各地域のパートナー・チームの詳細をご紹介しましょう。

EMEA

名実ともに強豪としてさらなる進化を遂げたEMEA。2025年では、Stage 2とStage 3のライブ・イベントで健闘し、それまで無敵と思われていたCrazy RaccoonやTeam Falcons相手に勝利。さらに、2026 World Finalsでは、Twisted MindsとAl Qadsiahがグランド・ファイナルで相まみえ、Twisted Mindsが4-1で接戦を制するなど、最近特に目覚ましい活躍を見せています。

今年は、Virtus.proとTwisted Minds、そして初登場のTeam PepsがEMEAのパートナー・チームとして参加します。今年もこの上昇気流を維持できるのか…現在最もホットなEMEAの今後の戦いに要注目です。

ASIA

ASIAのパートナー・チームは、Team Falcons、Crazy Raccoon、T1、Zeta Divisionと、「OW」eスポーツ界屈指の強豪ぞろい。2025年こそ「World Finals」栄冠の座を逃しましたが、今年もオフライン大会優勝候補の筆頭としてOWCSに挑みます。メタやロスターの変化を味方につけられるかどうかも注目すべきポイント。ASIAの強者たちが描き出す新たなチャプターには期待大と言えるでしょう。 

NA

NAからは、「オーバーウォッチ」eスポーツ界への堂々のカムバックを果たしたDallas Fuelと、Disguisedら新チーム2つと、SpacestationとTeam Liquidがパートナー・チームとして参加します。他の地域と同じく、去年以上のパフォーマンスが期待されるだけに、2月に開催される「Pre-season Bootcamp」での戦いぶりに注目が集まります。

CHINA

CHINA地域のチームが今年ついにOWCSパートナー・チームのプログラムに加わります。参加チームを含む詳細はまだ明かせませんが、下記のSNSアカウントで後日お伝えする予定です。続報にどうぞご期待ください。

配信プラットフォーム＆SNSアカウント

「オーバーウォッチ」eスポーツは2026年も引き続き、以下のチャンネルでお楽しみいただけます。ぜひアカウントをフォローして、最新情報をチェックしてみてください。

感謝をこめて

皆さんが「オーバーウォッチ」のゲーム本編とeスポーツ・プログラムに注いでくださる情熱が、私たちの活動の原動力です。このようなより素晴らしいプログラムを2026年に展開できるのも、ひとえに皆さんのエネルギーと献身があってこそ。この場を借りて感謝申し上げます。新年が近づきましたら、視聴方法を含む新情報をお届けします。それでは、1月にまたお会いしましょう！

Blizzard Entertainment

How it Works

Get Tender Every Month

At the beginning of each month, players with an active account in good standing will receive 500 Trader’s Tender automatically every month from a chest called the Collector’s Cache. If you don’t have active game time on your account or aren’t a subscriber at the start of a new month, don’t worry. Your Tender will be awarded on the first day of the month when you do have game time or an active subscription. This will be the same amount for everyone, regardless of how you pay for your game time.

The Traveler's Log

Complete monthly activities listed in the new Traveler’s Log. Each month features a rotating, themed set of activities. These activities provide the opportunity to earn up to 500 additional Trader’s Tender. There’s only a set amount of Tender you can earn each month through completing activities, so you won’t need to complete all the ones in the log each month. You’ll be able to pick and choose from a variety of fun in-game activities to easily earn Tender. Players can choose to earn by continuing to play the game as they already do, such as completing quests, competing in battlegrounds, participating in holiday activities, and even running Mythic+ dungeons. But you can also choose to take part in activities uniquely designed for the month.

Freeze an Item

Before the month comes to an end, if you haven’t purchased that one “must-have” item yet, don’t worry. You can “freeze” an item so you can purchase it later. When you freeze an item, it will stay available month over month until it is purchased or replaced.

If this month’s offerings didn’t have the items you wanted, you can hang on to your Trader’s Tender to spend later. It won’t go anywhere, and unspent Tender will continue to accumulate each month.

Learn more about the Trading Post from the news post on the official site.

*The Trading Post feature is not available in WoW Classic titles.
**Requires World of Warcraft Subscription or Game Time
***Requires Level 10 to access the Adventure Guide.
