item.title: Become Sanctuary’s Undoubted Saviour
item.description:
Diablo Immortal

Become Sanctuary’s Undoubted Saviour

Blizzard Entertainment

Well met, adventurer. Since we last gathered, you’ve braved the Shattered Wilds limited-time event and cleaved through the Boreal Nomads Battlepass. This content update brings enhanced server-matchmaking updates and improvements to Battleground, balance changes, and more.

As with previous content updates, there will be server maintenance starting on January 20, from 4 p.m.–6 p.m. PST for Oceania, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Europe servers, and on January 21, from 12 a.m.–2 a.m. PST for servers in the Americas. After the maintenance has concluded, all items mentioned below will be live—specific dates for any features going live afterward are provided below.

Codex

Battleground Cross-Region Matchmaking Updates

Balance Changes

Feature Updates

Bug Fixes

Battleground Cross Region-Matchmaking Updates

We’ve heard plenty of community feedback requesting enhanced PvP matchmaking across more servers. We’re implementing a suite of changes to Battleground matchmaking with the goal to improve the overall Battleground experience by having stronger and more diverse opponents and reduce matchmaking wait times.

Cross-Region Battleground Matchmaking (Phase One)

Starting with this content update, North American and South American servers will now be matched to compete against each other in Battleground.

This increases the available matchmaking pool, helping to get better matches, faster queue times, especially during off-peak hours.

This is part one of our planned cross-region matchmaking changes. We’ll continue to monitor your feedback and performance to determine future improvements and next steps.

Expanded Battleground Availability

To better accommodate for time zone differences across North and South American regions, we’re expanding the daily Battleground availability window so more players can participate during their preferred local time to play.

New Timing:

Round 1 – Battleground

  • BRT (South America servers): 8:00 a.m.—12:00 p.m.
  • ET (North America East servers): 6:00 a.m.—10:00 a.m.
  • PT (North America West servers): 3:00 a.m.—7:00 a.m.

Round 2 – Battleground

  • BRT: 12:00 p.m.—4:00 p.m.
  • ET: 10:00 a.m.—2:00 p.m.
  • PT: 7:00 a.m.—11:00 a.m.

Round 3 – Convoy

  • BRT: 6:00 p.m.—10:00 p.m.
  • ET: 4:00 p.m.—8:00 p.m.
  • PT: 1:00 p.m.—5:00 p.m.

Round 3 – Battleground

  • BRT: 10:00 p.m.—5:00 a.m.
  • ET: 8:00 p.m.—3:00 a.m.
  • PT: 5:00 p.m.—12:00 a.m.

Season Transitions

The end of the current Battleground season and the start of the next Battleground season will occur around the following times:

  • BRT: 6:00 a.m. local time
  • ET: 4:00 a.m. local time
  • PT: 2:00 a.m. local time

Class Based Matchmaking Changes

We’ve also implemented a matchmaking change for Battleground that prioritizes putting different classes on separate teams. Additionally, as more players join the match, it will priority will be to separate similar classes to ensure varied teams.

Match Quality and Latency Adjustments

With cross-region matchmaking enabled, some matches may experience slightly higher latency if you’re playing with someone from a different region. If you happen to matchmake with other players from a local server, we’ll try and prioritize a faster and more stable connection by only using local servers.

We’ll continue to monitor any latency issues, match quality, and your feedback after these changes.

Back to Top

Balances Changes

These balance changes will be effective everywhere across Diablo Immortal.

Crusader

  • Zeaflair (Helm)
    • Previous: Sweep Attack damage increased by 19%.
    • Now: Sweep Attack converts 25% of its damage dealt into a shield for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30% of your maximum Life.
  • Upturned Gaze (Shoulders)
    • Previous: Judgment now grants you an Aura of Judgement, marking nearby enemies with the cross, Slowing them and causing them to suffer additional damage when struck by your Primary Attack.
    • Now: Judgment now grants you an Aura of Judgement, marking nearby enemies with the cross, Slowing them. When a marked enemy is struck by your Primary Attack, they take additional damage that is considered Primary Attack damage.
    • Note: Judgement damage from this essence should now scale with Primary Attack damage instead of Skill damage.
  • Remonstrant Mace
    • Previous: Sweep Attack now grants you a Holy Flail for a short duration, causing your Primary Attack to sweep through enemies in a wide arc.
    • Now: Sweep Attack now makes you briefly Immune to knockback and total loss of control and grants you a Holy Flail for a short duration, causing your Primary Attack to sweep through enemies in a wide arc that deals increased damage with each successive hit.
    • Note: This grants immunity to CC for 2 seconds after using Sweep Attack and the damage increase scales from a 16% increase to a 96% increase.
  • Harras of the Steppes
    • Previous: Draw and Quarter now calls a swiftwind steed for you to ride, increasing your Primary Attack Speed.
    • Now: Draw and Quarter now calls a swiftwind steed for you to ride, increasing your Primary Attack Speed and causing your Primary Attacks to deal wind damage. Additionally, you cannot be dismounted from your steed when you suffer total loss of control, but your Skill damage is reduced by 45% while mounted.
    • Note: The gusts of wind left behind to boost Movement Speed has been removed to refocus this essence on damage instead of support.

Demon Hunter

  • Agony’s Specter (Shoulders)
    • Previous: Escape now causes you to roll a short distance, empowering you and allowing your Primary Attack to shoot twice at once.
    • Updates: Escape distance increased from 2y to 4y. Projectile speed increased. Attack animation speed increased.
    • Note: Overall, this aims to increase the distance Demon Hunter can travel while making the attacks fired more likely to land because the skill is overall more responsive.
  • Brutal Temperance (Chest)
    • Previous: Vengeance now causes your Primary Attacks to also fire piercing rounds for a short while.
    • Updates: Damage increased from 90% base damage to 120%.
  • Twisted Wyrd (Mainhand)
    • Previous: Multishot now causes your Primary Attack to also shoot explosive shells for a short while.
    • Updates: Damage increased from 80% base damage to 120%. Projectile speed increased.

Druid

  • Wanton Buck (Pants)
    • Previous: Stag Charge now causes you to sprint forward as a stag, during which you are immune to loss of control and knockback, damaging and knocking back any enemies you hit.
    • Now: Stag Charge now grants you brief immunity to knockback and loss of control while causing you to sprint forward as a stag, damaging and knocking back any enemies you hit.
    • Note: Immunity duration is 1 second.
  • Saved by Nature
    • Previous: Circle of Life now grants nearby allies a regenerative seed that continuously heals Life and heals a large amount if their Life drops too low.
    • Updates: The passive healing proc when the skill is off cooldown has been removed. The player must have an active Circle of Life heal on them in order to receive the low life trigger.

Back to Top

Feature Updates

Normal Gem Stack Changes

Normal Gems can now be stacked up to 9,999. This is also the new max stack amount when listing Normal Gems to the in-game Market.

Back to Top

Bug Fixes

Looking for the latest round of hotfixes and bug fixes implemented for Diablo Immortal? Check here for all-platform fixes—updated on Tuesdays.

We hope you’ve all had a fantastic start to the new year, and we look forward to sharing many more hellacious moments with you in 2026!
—The Diablo Immortal Team

Back to Top

item.title: WoW Weekly: Midnight Draws Near, Last Weekend of Legion Remix, and More!
item.description:
World of Warcraft

WoW Weekly: Midnight Draws Near, Last Weekend of Legion Remix, and More!

Blizzard Entertainment

Gear up for the thrilling Midnight Pre-Expansion update, prepare to venture once more through the legendary Dark Portal with the Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Pre-Patch, dive into Legion Remix this weekend, and claim a Decor item via Twitch Drop! Be sure to check in each week for fresh challenges and incredible rewards awaiting you in Azeroth.

The Midnight Pre-Expansion Content Update Goes Live January 20!

The first shadows of the Void fall upon Azeroth as the Midnight Pre-Expansion Content Update goes live January 20. Players can explore the new User Interface (UI) updates, experiment with new combat design changes across all classes, walk the path of the Demon Hunter Devourer, and more.

What’s Inside:

  • New Demon Hunter Specialization—Devourer
  • New Race and Class Combination: Void Elf Demon Hunters
  • Class Combat Design Updates
  • Stat and Item Squish
  • User Interface Updates
  • Transmogrification Updates
  • Player vs. Player (PvP) Training Grounds
  • Housing and Endeavors
  • Pre-expansion event
  • The Winds of Mysterious Fortune Returns

Don't miss the Pre-Expansion Update Survival Guide—join World of Warcraft Community Managers Liinxy and Kaivax as they highlight the exciting new features coming to Azeroth in the Midnight Pre-Expansion Update!

Read all about these features and more from our previously published article.

WoW®: Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition Pre-Patch Now Live

Prepare to tread once again through the Dark Portal and into the fel-scarred realm of Outland with the WoW®: Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition on February 5 at 3:00 pm PST globally, and included with your WoW Subscription or Game Time.

Your journey continues with a level increase to level 70, an increased level cadence, three challenging Raids, two playable races, Guild Bank, and a slew of other features.

Learn more about Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Edition, including important details about features and character transfers, from our previously published article.

Embrace the Chaos of the Final Weekend of Legion Remix

Log in anytime from Friday, January 16, 8:00 am PST through to the end of Remix to earn the Feat of Strength, Cloudy With a Chance of Infernals.

When the dust settles and you find yourself returned to the main timeline in Azeroth, any Remix-specific items, equipment, and quests will be removed. Each transferred character will receive 2,000 gold and a set of item level 655 (102 after the squish) armor and weapons along with retaining any gold earned during Legion Remix.

Like sand through the hourglass, time is running out before the timeline in Legion Remix collapses. Before that happens, make sure to get in there and spend your Bronze on the items you want most to add to your collections before January 19.

While a vendor will remain available to purchase Legion Remix Housing decor items afterward, purchasing them during Legion Remix offers the best value!

More details, including the cost of items, can be found in our article.

Twitch Drop: Get the Cuddly Green Grrgle Housing Decor Item January 20!

Get the Cuddly Green Grrgle Housing decor item starting January 20! Players who have claimed this new item from the Twitch Drop will also be able to visit Dennia Silvertongue in Silvermoon City to purchase more copies of this adorable item after the launch of Midnight on March 2. Additional copies can also be purchased from Tuuran in Stormwind and Gabbi in Orgrimmar (near the Trading Post) beginning with the release of the Midnight Pre-Expansion Content Update.

Watch 4 hours of any World of Warcraft content stream on Twitch.tv from January 20 at 10:00 am PST until February 17 at 10:00 am PST while these Twitch Drops are active to claim the Cuddly Green Grrgle Housing decor item. 

Start Time: January 20, 10:00 am PST
End Time: February 17, 10:00 am PST

To participate, you must link your Twitch account by visiting https://account.battle.net/connections. If you have changed your password or made any changes to your Twitch or Battle.net account, you will have to relink your accounts. When you relink, there will be a 7-day cooldown before you can relink a new Twitch account. After you’ve claimed your rewards on Twitch, please make sure you’re logging into the Battle.net region you’d like to receive the drop(s) on, as the first region you log into will be where your items will be delivered. It can take up to 24 hours to receive your reward(s) in-game after claiming. Read our Frequently Asked Questions section for more information.

Frequently asked questions can be found in our previously published article.

Gallop into the New Year with a 6-Month Subscription

Blaze through your World of Warcraft® adventures in the saddle of the Scorching Valor Skyriding mount. Also, you'll have no shortage of backbone with the Smoldering Courage pet cheering you on!

Unlock special items with a 6-Month or 12-Month Subscription:

  • Scorching Valor Skyriding Mount: Soar through the skies of World of Warcraft® astride this fiery new mount.
  • Smoldering Courage Pet: Invite unbridled enthusiasm into your WoW® Classic progression (currently Mists of Pandaria Classic™) journey.

Players on existing 6-Month or 12-Month recurring subscription plans with a future renewal date will automatically receive the mount and pet at no additional charge.

  • Items will be granted through Battle.net by January 31, 2026.
  • Be sure to redeem your items by July 31, 2026.

Certain restrictions apply. Visit shop.battle.net for more information.

Subscribe Now

Outfit Your Adventures in Outland with the Dark Portal Pack

Enhance your experience and prepare to tread through the Dark Portal into the fel-scarred realm of Outland with World of Warcraft®: Burning Crusade Classic™ Anniversary Edition launching February 5.

Join fellow heroes of Azeroth and rally to face the might of the Burning Legion as you adventure across the shattered skies and torn lands of an exiled world with fel-bound cosmetics. The Anniversary Dark Portal Pack includes the following:

  • Viridian Phase-Hunter (Modern Ground Mount)
  • Re-Awakened Phase-Hunter (Classic Anniversary and Classic Progression Ground Mount)
  • Dark Portal Hearthstone Effect (Classic Anniversary and Classic Progression Toy)
  • Path of Illidan (Classic Anniversary and Classic Progression Toy)

The price of the pack is dynamic, meaning if you already have one or more items listed in the pack as part of your in-game Collection, the pack's price automatically adjusts. All items from the Dark Portal Pack are also available as standalone purchases.

Visit the Shop

Return each week to the World of Warcraft news site, where together, we’ll forge your destinies in Azeroth and beyond. Lok'tar Ogar!
